title: Paolla Oliveira Takes 'The Stranger in Bed' to the Book Biennial
seoTitle: Paolla Oliveira Takes 'The Stranger in Bed' to Book.
subtitle: Actress Discusses Raphael Montes' Novel and Models a R$ 5.6k Mugler Dress
excerpt: At the São Paulo Book Biennial, Paolla Oliveira discussed Raphael Montes' 'The Stranger in Bed' and appeared in a transparent Mugler dress, valued at.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Paolla Oliveira participated in the São Paulo Book Biennial this Friday (4) to discuss Raphael Montes' novel "The Stranger in Bed" and announce that the work will be adapted for cinema.

The Book Headed for the Big Screen

"The Stranger in Bed," written by Raphael Montes, was the central theme of Paolla Oliveira's interview at the event. The work is scheduled to become a film, with the actress in the lead role and directed by Esmir Filho, known for "Homem com H."

Details of the Film Adaptation

The film production will feature Paolla Oliveira as the protagonist and will have Esmir Filho at the helm of direction, responsible for biographies such as Ney Matogrosso's.

The Eye-Catching Dress

At the public meeting, the actress chose a light translucent dress from the Mugler brand, sold by the online store My Theresa for 945 euros, a value that corresponds to approximately R$ 5.6 thousand at the current exchange rate, not including import taxes.

Garment Features

The model is entirely draped, with a halter neckline and an open back. Made with 94% recycled polyamide and 6% elastane, the outfit features ruched details that sculpt the silhouette and give a subtle sheen to the light beige color.

Accessories and Style

Paolla completed the look with relaxed loose hair, crystal earrings, and slingback shoes in the color of the dress. The contrast between nude sandals or pumps and a skin-tone shade helps to elongate the silhouette, while discreet accessories balance the ensemble.

Event Repercussion

During the session, fans present had the opportunity to hear the actress comment on the plot and the anticipation surrounding the adaptation, while also appreciating the choice of a look that combines sophistication and sustainability through recycled polyamide.

With information from Terra.
